no latency, and this is not a failure.
Most callers wait quietly · D111

claude-sonnet-5

div.style: color: rgb(43, 40, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the rule-based summary simply stays.
Nothing on the screen changes, nothing
is missing, and nobody waited.
This is the ORDINARY case — on a laptop
with no key it is the only case
